The whole of [Structure](elements-structure.qmd) on one sheet. Each example is a miniature of the form, its sections labelled with letters. Press **Full screen** to put the sheet on the whole screen for
revision or for the class board.

## The sheet

::::::: {.el-sheet .column-page data-title="Structure: how a piece is built"}
:::::: {.el-grid}

::::: {.el-card}
#### Phrases and sections
<p>A <strong>phrase</strong> is a musical sentence, usually 2, 4 or 8 [measures]{.nn}, ending in a cadence. Sections change: new tune, key, instruments, texture or mood. The first idea is <strong>A</strong>, the next new one <strong>B</strong>.</p>
:::::

::::: {.el-card}
#### Binary: A B
<p>Two sections, usually both repeated (A A B B). Baroque dances.</p>
<div class="abc-ex" data-width="190" data-bpm="110"><script type="text/plain">
X:1
M:3/4
L:1/4
K:G
|:"^A""G"G B d|"D"A3:||:"^B""D"d f a|"G"g3:|]
</script></div>
:::::

::::: {.el-card}
#### Ternary: A B A
<p>A, a contrasting B, then A again (exact, or changed: A B A′).</p>
<div class="abc-ex" data-width="190" data-bpm="100"><script type="text/plain">
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/4
K:C
"^A""C"E G c2|"^B""Am"A, C E2|"^A""C"E G c2|]
</script></div>
:::::

::::: {.el-card}
#### Rondo: A B A C A
<p>A <strong>refrain</strong> keeps coming back, with contrasting <strong>episodes</strong> between.</p>
<div class="abc-ex" data-width="190" data-bpm="120"><script type="text/plain">
X:1
M:2/4
L:1/8
K:F
"^A"c2 A2|"^B"d2 f2|"^A"c2 A2|"^C"B,2 D2|"^A"F4|]
</script></div>
:::::

::::: {.el-card}
#### Strophic: A A A
<p>The same music for every verse, new words each time: hymns, folk songs. The opposite, music that keeps changing to follow the words, is <strong>through-composed</strong>.</p>
:::::

::::: {.el-card}
#### Minuet and trio
<p>A dance in 3/4. Minuet (A A B B), a contrasting <strong>trio</strong> (C C D D), then the minuet again without repeats (A B). Ternary overall.</p>
:::::

::::: {.el-card}
#### Theme and variations
<p>A tune, then changed versions of it: new rhythm, harmony, key or instruments.</p>
<div class="abc-ex" data-width="190" data-bpm="100"><script type="text/plain">
X:1
M:4/4
L:1/8
K:C
C2C2 G2G2|CECE GBGB|]
</script></div>
:::::

::::: {.el-card}
#### Song forms
<ul>
<li><strong>Verse–chorus</strong>: intro, verse, chorus, verse, chorus, bridge, chorus, outro</li>
<li><strong>AABA</strong> (32-bar song): four 8-[measure]{.nn} sections; B is the <em>bridge</em> or <em>middle eight</em></li>
<li><strong>12-bar blues</strong>: one 12-[measure]{.nn} chord pattern, repeated</li></ul>
:::::

::::: {.el-card .el-wide}
#### Check yourself
<div class="eq" data-set="structure"></div>
:::::

::::::
:::::::

## Describing structure

- Label the sections with letters as they come, and say what changes at each new letter.
- Marking sections in a recording: [Section Labels](section-labels.qmd).
